title: A date reader
description:
Find dates written in different ways in a text.

```
2026-11-20
20/11/2026
Nov 20, 2026
found 3 dates, all 2026-11-20
```
hints: `for y, m, d in text:gmatch("(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)") do ... end` gives the captures as strings; `tonumber` them (lesson 4.03).
requirements: Use `string.gmatch` with three patterns: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `DD/MM/YYYY` and `Mon DD, YYYY`.
A month name table turns `Nov` into 11.
stretch: Check that each date is real (no 31 November).
